summary: The Z in ansible-core X.Y.Z is the patch version, released on a four-week schedule with bug and security fixes per the support matrix.
questions: How often are ansible-core patch releases published?
What do ansible-core patch releases contain?

answer_card.title: Patch releases (the Z)
answer_card.answer_md: `Z` is the patch version. ansible-core ships patches on a **4-week** schedule, with bug and security fixes according to the support matrix.
